description: floatCSEP is a Python application for specifying and running reproducible earthquake-forecast experiments. The JOSS paper explains its catalogue handling, forecast generation, evaluation, visualization and reporting around pyCSEP. Its own README identifies the experiment configuration and BSD-3-Clause licence. Spatial coverage is the forecast region and temporal coverage is the chosen prospective or retrospective test window. The results can help select or challenge seismic forecasts before they feed building or network exposure simulations. A caveat is that a reproducible experiment does not guarantee forecast skill, and forecast skill does not directly estimate asset damage. Catalogue completeness and evaluation rules matter. The separate pyCSEP evaluation toolkit was drafted earlier in this G5 review; floatCSEP is the experiment orchestration layer. No matching catalogue or first-review record was found. The article and own source were read without launching an experiment. No directly related catalogue record was established.
name: floatCSEP earthquake forecast experiments
